other_errors.why: The answer leaves out or excludes four needed matters whose files it had grepped at [36]-[37] or whose emails it read at [51]-[83], judging them as requests, drafts or pending from emails and snippets and never opening their closing memos or checklists.

runs.failure_point: Five needed matters that its inventories and scan surfaced were never opened, and one read matter was excluded as request-only.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Five needed matters surfaced in its inventories and its candidate scan at [33] (four with comfort-letter hits), but the reads at [38]-[66] covered nine other candidates and those five were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The harness list in the scan review at [27] named all five among surfaced matters never opened; the screening stage read none of them.

other_errors.why: The answer excludes a needed matter as a request or planning precedent although it read that matter's closing memorandum and comfort-letter emails at [38]-[66].

divergence: All fail in the same way: every run surfaced all twelve matters early (path searches or inventories) but read only about ten hand-picked candidates, leaving four or five needed matters unopened (first error at the screening or snippet stage that chose what to open), and then excluded some opened ones as request-only or pending. Precision passed in all three. T2 opened and credited the most matters (seven) by reading closing memos and binders rather than emails; T0 read mostly emails and credited four. The harness lists of unopened matters named the missing matters in T0 and T2, and the agents still did not open them; in T1 the screening review even recommended excluding one needed matter as pending.
